name: where-knowledge-lives-hu-en-zh
description: 70 factual/concept items in Hungarian, English and Chinese, built for measuring whether a multilingual LLM reaches language-bound knowledge directly or through English.
license: CC BY 4.0 (items authored for this measurement; the selection criterion uses Wikidata sitelinks)

selection.ZH: article on zh.wikipedia or Baidu Baike, none on en/hu Wikipedia (Wikidata sitelinks)
selection.HU: article on hu.wikipedia, none on en/zh
selection.UNT: untranslatable concepts (8 Hungarian, 8 Chinese) with pre-registered native meaning components, distortion markers, an English approximation and a well-translatable control word
